messages.content: Help me add statements for initializing properties named 'width' and 'height' for a receiver object named 'shape' into an existing statements array named 'shapeStatements'?

function.name: addInitializedPropertyStatements
function.description: This function adds statements for initializing properties to an array of statements. It is designed to work with TypeScript's AST manipulation. Note that the provided function is in JavaScript syntax.

statements.description: The array of statements to which the new initialized property statements will be added. This is JavaScript array type parameter in string representation. The list elements are of type String; they are not in string representation.

property.description: An array of property names that need to be initialized. Default empty array This is JavaScript array type parameter in string representation. The list elements are of type String; they are not in string representation.

receiver.description: The name of the object for which the properties are being initialized. This is JavaScript String type parameter in string representation.
